
<script>
const AUTHOR_ID = '3227042';
const MANUAL_PUBLICATIONS_URL = './manual_publications.json';
const AUTHOR_PROFILE_URL = 'https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=ZOgedfAAAAAJ&hl=en';
const SCHOLAR_PROXY_URL = `https://api.allorigins.win/raw?url=${encodeURIComponent(AUTHOR_PROFILE_URL)}`;
const PAPERS_API_URL = `https://api.semanticscholar.org/graph/v1/author/${AUTHOR_ID}/papers?fields=title,year,venue,authors,citationCount,externalIds,publicationTypes,abstract,openAccessPdf&limit=100`;
let latestPapers = [];
let latestSummary = { total: 0, conference: 0, journalReview: 0, other: 0 };

function toFiniteInt(value, fallback = 0) {
  const parsed = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return fallback;
  return Math.max(0, Math.round(parsed));
}

function formatMetricDate(value) {
  if (!value) return '';
  const date = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return '';
  return date.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' });
}

function normalizePaper(paper) {
  const citationCount = Number(paper?.citationCount ?? paper?.citations ?? 0);
  const publicationTypes = Array.isArray(paper?.publicationTypes)
    ? paper.publicationTypes
    : paper?.pub_type ? [paper.pub_type] : [];
  const externalIds = paper?.externalIds || (paper?.doi_url
    ? { DOI: paper.doi_url.replace(/^https:\/\/doi\.org\//, '') }
    : {});
  const openAccessPdf = paper?.openAccessPdf || (paper?.pdf_url
    ? { url: paper.pdf_url }
    : null);

  return {
    title: paper?.title || '',
    year: Number(paper?.year || 0),
    venue: paper?.venue || '',
    authors: Array.isArray(paper?.authors)
      ? paper.authors.map(author => typeof author === 'string' ? { name: author } : author).filter(author => author?.name)
      : [],
    citationCount: Number.isFinite(citationCount) ? citationCount : 0,
    externalIds,
    publicationTypes,
    abstract: paper?.abstract || '',
    openAccessPdf,
  };
}

function publicationKey(paper) {
  const doi = paper.externalIds?.DOI ? String(paper.externalIds.DOI).toLowerCase() : '';
  if (doi) return `doi:${doi}`;
  return `title:${paper.title.trim().toLowerCase()}|year:${paper.year || 0}`;
}

function mergePublications(primaryPapers, manualPapers) {
  const merged = new Map();

  [...manualPapers, ...primaryPapers]
    .map(normalizePaper)
    .filter(paper => paper.title)
    .forEach(paper => {
      merged.set(publicationKey(paper), paper);
    });

  return Array.from(merged.values()).sort((a, b) => {
    const yearDiff = Number(b.year || 0) - Number(a.year || 0);
    return yearDiff !== 0 ? yearDiff : paperTitleCompare(a.title, b.title);
  });
}

function paperTitleCompare(a, b) {
  return String(a || '').localeCompare(String(b || ''));
}

function publicationBadgeType(paper) {
  const publicationTypes = paper.publicationTypes || [];
  if (publicationTypes.includes('Conference')) return 'Conference';
  if (publicationTypes.includes('Review')) return 'Review';
  if (publicationTypes.includes('Book')) return 'Book Chapter';
  return 'Journal';
}

async function loadManualPublications() {
  const response = await fetch(MANUAL_PUBLICATIONS_URL, { cache: 'no-cache' });
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Manual publications status: ${response.status}`);
  }

  const json = await response.json();
  return Array.isArray(json.papers) ? json.papers : [];
}

function renderYearSection(year, items) {
  const cards = items.map((item, index) => {
    const authors = item.authors?.map(a => a.name === 'Aryabrata Basu' ? '<strong>Aryabrata Basu</strong>' : a.name).join(', ') || '';
    const venue = item.venue ? `<div class="pub-venue">${item.venue}</div>` : '';
    const pubType = publicationBadgeType(item);

    const citationText = Number(item.citationCount || 0) > 0 ? `<span class="pub-cite">${item.citationCount} citations</span>` : '';
    const badgeClass = pubType.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-');
    const doi = item.externalIds && item.externalIds.DOI ? `https://doi.org/${item.externalIds.DOI}` : '';
    const pdf = item.openAccessPdf && item.openAccessPdf.url ? item.openAccessPdf.url : '';

    const links = [];
    if (doi) links.push(`<a href="${doi}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">DOI ↗</a>`);
    if (pdf) links.push(`<a href="${pdf}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">PDF ↗</a>`);

    const abstract = item.abstract ? item.abstract.trim() : '';
    const abstractId = `pub-abstract-${year}-${index}`;
    const abstractBlock = abstract
      ? `
        <div class="pub-abstract-wrap">
          <button class="pub-abstract-toggle" type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="${abstractId}">Abstract ▾</button>
          <div id="${abstractId}" class="pub-abstract hidden">${abstract}</div>
        </div>
      `
      : '';

    return `
      <article class="pub-item" data-type="${pubType}">
        <div class="pub-meta">
          <span class="pub-type ${badgeClass}">${pubType}</span>
          ${citationText}
        </div>
        <h3 class="pub-title">${item.title}</h3>
        <div class="pub-authors">${authors}</div>
        ${venue}
        <div class="pub-links">${links.join('')}</div>
        ${abstractBlock}
      </article>
    `;
  }).join('');

  return `
    <div class="pub-year-group">
      <div class="pub-year">${year}</div>
      <div class="pub-year-items">${cards}</div>
    </div>
  `;
}

function summaryCategory(paper) {
  const pubType = publicationBadgeType(paper);
  if (pubType === 'Conference') return 'conference';
  if (pubType === 'Journal' || pubType === 'Review') return 'journalReview';
  return 'other';
}

function computeDerivedStats(papers) {
  const citationCounts = papers.map((paper) => toFiniteInt(paper.citationCount)).sort((a, b) => b - a);
  const citationCount = citationCounts.reduce((sum, count) => sum + count, 0);
  const i10Index = citationCounts.filter((count) => count >= 10).length;
  let hIndex = 0;
  citationCounts.forEach((count, index) => {
    if (count >= index + 1) hIndex = index + 1;
  });
  return {
    citationCount,
    hIndex,
    i10Index,
    paperCount: papers.length,
  };
}

function normalizeStats(rawStats, papers, lastUpdatedFallback = null) {
  const derived = computeDerivedStats(papers);
  const citationCount = toFiniteInt(rawStats?.citationCount, derived.citationCount);
  return {
    citationCount,
    hIndex: toFiniteInt(rawStats?.hIndex, derived.hIndex),
    i10Index: toFiniteInt(rawStats?.i10Index, derived.i10Index),
    paperCount: toFiniteInt(rawStats?.paperCount, derived.paperCount),
    source: rawStats?.source || 'Google Scholar',
    profileUrl: rawStats?.profileUrl || AUTHOR_PROFILE_URL,
    lastUpdated: rawStats?.lastUpdated || lastUpdatedFallback || null,
  };
}

function renderMetricsSource(stats, mode) {
  const sourceNode = document.getElementById('pub-metrics-source');
  if (!sourceNode) return;
  const dateText = formatMetricDate(stats.lastUpdated);
  const freshnessLabel = mode === 'live'
    ? 'Live publications with'
    : mode === 'live-pending'
      ? 'Live publications; refreshing'
      : mode === 'local-cache'
        ? 'Cached'
        : 'Snapshot';
  const profileUrl = stats.profileUrl || AUTHOR_PROFILE_URL;
  sourceNode.innerHTML = dateText
    ? `${freshnessLabel} ${stats.source} metrics updated ${dateText}. <a href="${profileUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">View profile ↗</a>`
    : `${freshnessLabel} ${stats.source} metrics. <a href="${profileUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">View profile ↗</a>`;
}

function renderSummaryMetrics(summary, rawStats = null, options = {}) {
  const stats = normalizeStats(rawStats, latestPapers, options.lastUpdated);
  const averageCitations = summary.total
    ? (stats.citationCount / summary.total).toFixed(1)
    : '0.0';

  document.getElementById('pub-total-count').textContent = summary.total;
  document.getElementById('pub-citation-count').textContent = stats.citationCount;
  document.getElementById('pub-conf-count').textContent = summary.conference;
  document.getElementById('pub-journal-count').textContent = summary.journalReview;
  document.getElementById('pub-other-count').textContent = summary.other;
  document.getElementById('pub-h-index').textContent = stats.hIndex;
  document.getElementById('pub-i10-index').textContent = stats.i10Index;
  document.getElementById('pub-average-citations').textContent = averageCitations;
  renderMetricsSource(stats, options.mode || 'snapshot');
}

function renderPublications(papers, rawStats = null, options = {}) {
  const container = document.getElementById('publications-list');
  if (!container) return;

  const byYear = {};
  papers.forEach(p => {
    const year = Number(p.year || 0);
    if (!year) return;
    if (!byYear[year]) byYear[year] = [];
    byYear[year].push(p);
  });

  const years = Object.keys(byYear).sort((a, b) => Number(b) - Number(a));
  const html = years.map(year => renderYearSection(year, byYear[year])).join('');
  container.innerHTML = html;

  document.querySelectorAll('.pub-abstract-toggle').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const abstract = btn.nextElementSibling;
      const isHidden = abstract.classList.toggle('hidden');
      btn.textContent = isHidden ? 'Abstract ▾' : 'Abstract ▴';
      btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!isHidden));
    });
  });

  const summary = papers.reduce((counts, paper) => {
    counts.total += 1;
    counts[summaryCategory(paper)] += 1;
    return counts;
  }, { total: 0, conference: 0, journalReview: 0, other: 0 });
  latestPapers = papers;
  latestSummary = summary;
  renderSummaryMetrics(summary, rawStats, options);

  const activeFilter = document.querySelector('.pub-filter.active')?.dataset.filter || 'all';
  if (activeFilter === 'all') {
    document.getElementById('publications-status').textContent = `${summary.total} publications loaded.`;
  } else {
    filterPublications(activeFilter, true);
  }
}

function filterPublications(type, updateStatus = true) {
  const items = document.querySelectorAll('.pub-item');
  items.forEach(item => {
    const match = type === 'all' || item.dataset.type === type;
    item.style.display = match ? '' : 'none';
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.pub-year-group').forEach(group => {
    const visible = group.querySelectorAll('.pub-item:not([style*="display: none"])').length;
    group.style.display = visible ? '' : 'none';
  });

  if (updateStatus) {
    const visibleCount = document.querySelectorAll('.pub-item:not([style*="display: none"])').length;
    document.getElementById('publications-status').textContent = `Showing ${visibleCount} publications.`;
  }
}

document.querySelectorAll('.pub-filter').forEach(btn => {
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.pub-filter').forEach(b => {
      b.classList.remove('active');
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
    });
    btn.classList.add('active');
    btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
    filterPublications(btn.dataset.filter);
  });
});

async function fetchSemanticScholarPapers() {
  const response = await fetch(PAPERS_API_URL, { cache: 'no-cache' });
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Publications API status: ${response.status}`);
  }
  const json = await response.json();
  return (json.data || []).filter((paper) => paper && paper.title);
}

function extractScholarStatsFromHtml(html) {
  const tableMatch = html.match(/<table id="gsc_rsb_st"[\s\S]*?<\/table>/i);
  if (!tableMatch) {
    throw new Error('Google Scholar stats table not found');
  }
  const table = tableMatch[0];

  function readMetric(label) {
    const pattern = new RegExp(
      `<tr>\\s*<td class="gsc_rsb_sc1">[\\s\\S]*?${label}[\\s\\S]*?<\\/td>\\s*<td class="gsc_rsb_std">\\s*([0-9,]+)\\s*<\\/td>`,
      'i'
    );
    const match = table.match(pattern);
    if (!match) {
      throw new Error(`Google Scholar metric missing: ${label}`);
    }
    return toFiniteInt(match[1].replace(/,/g, ''));
  }

  return {
    citationCount: readMetric('Citations'),
    hIndex: readMetric('h-index'),
    i10Index: readMetric('i10-index'),
  };
}

async function fetchGoogleScholarStats() {
  const response = await fetch(SCHOLAR_PROXY_URL, { cache: 'no-cache' });
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Scholar proxy status: ${response.status}`);
  }
  const html = await response.text();
  const stats = extractScholarStatsFromHtml(html);
  return {
    ...stats,
    source: 'Google Scholar',
    profileUrl: AUTHOR_PROFILE_URL,
    lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

async function fetchPublishedSnapshot() {
  const response = await fetch('./publications_cache.json', { cache: 'no-cache' });
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Cache status: ${response.status}`);
  }
  return response.json();
}

async function fetchPublications() {
  const [manualPapers, snapshot] = await Promise.all([
    loadManualPublications().catch(() => []),
    fetchPublishedSnapshot().catch(() => null),
  ]);

  const snapshotStats = snapshot?.stats || null;
  const snapshotUpdated = snapshotStats?.lastUpdated || snapshot?.last_updated || null;
  const snapshotPapers = mergePublications(snapshot?.papers || [], manualPapers);
  if (snapshotPapers.length) {
    renderPublications(snapshotPapers, snapshotStats, {
      mode: 'snapshot',
      lastUpdated: snapshotUpdated,
    });
  }

  let liveScholarStats = null;
  const scholarStatsPromise = fetchGoogleScholarStats();
  scholarStatsPromise
    .then((stats) => {
      liveScholarStats = stats;
      if (latestSummary.total > 0) {
        renderSummaryMetrics(latestSummary, stats, {
          mode: 'live',
          lastUpdated: stats.lastUpdated,
        });
      }
    })
    .catch(() => {});

  try {
    const papers = await fetchSemanticScholarPapers();
    renderPublications(mergePublications(papers, manualPapers), liveScholarStats || snapshotStats, {
      mode: liveScholarStats ? 'live' : 'live-pending',
      lastUpdated: liveScholarStats?.lastUpdated || snapshotUpdated || new Date().toISOString(),
    });
  } catch {
    if (!snapshotPapers.length) {
      document.getElementById('publications-status').classList.remove('visually-hidden');
      document.getElementById('publications-status').textContent = 'Publications could not be loaded. Please try again later.';
      document.getElementById('pub-metrics-source').textContent = 'Publication metrics are currently unavailable.';
    }
  }
}

fetchPublications();
</script>
